name: Monterey
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Monterey Chardonnay is associated with mango and guava.

blurb.text: A long Central Coast AVA running from Monterey Bay south through the Salinas Valley. The north is cool with a very long growing season. Pinot Noir and Riesling grow nearer the cold Pacific, and Bordeaux grapes in the warmer south.
